## Connecting prose

A paragraph written without a fenced div is an unstyled step — it highlights
nothing, but it takes its place in the sequence. All four constructs treat it the
same way; `.explain-code` used to drop it silently.

::: {.explain-code}
```{.go}
row := b.freeRow(col)
b.cells[row][col] = p
```
